description:
Proposed internal refurbishment and partial reconfiguration of existing Grade II listed five-storey townhouse at 6 Wallside, Barbican, including the removal of later non-original, unsympathetic internal alterations together with the restoration of original architectural features and finishes.

Level 0, works include refurbishment and partial like-for-like repair/replacement of elements of the existing entrance door assembly within the recessed porch, removal of a later glazed screen between the entrance hall and staircase, conversion of the former garage into a utility/laundry room behind retained existing garage door, reconstruction of the existing non-original guest bedroom en-suite shower/WC, replacement of internal doors and frames, new integrated joinery and associated redecoration and floor finishes. Throughout the house, the original staircase will be restored through removal of later enclosed riser infills together with repolishing of the original hardwood stair treads.

Level 1, works include removal of later fitted wardrobes and partitions, alterations to create a separate family bathroom, replacement bathroom fittings and finishes, replacement of internal doors and frames, new integrated joinery and reinstatement of original exposed smooth-cast concrete wall panels with visible aggregate finishes currently concealed beneath later plaster and paint finishes.

Level 2, the existing non-original kitchen will be replaced with a new kitchen designed as a sympathetic contemporary interpretation of the original Barbican architectural language, together with alterations to non-structural partitions and service boxing, replacement of an inappropriate later balustrade with a new hardwood balustrade and glazed safety screen, new integrated storage and sliding doors, replacement of internal doors and frames, and restoration of original exposed concrete wall finishes within the kitchen and living room areas. At Level 3, the existing non-original wardrobe, bathroom arrangements, partitions and later staircase insertion associated with the guest WC will be removed. The floor will be reconfigured to provide a larger en-suite shower/WC to Bedroom 1, a separate guest WC, a new integrated service cupboard, replacement of internal doors and frames including new flush sliding pocket doors, and associated bespoke joinery.

At Level 4, works include removal of a non-structural service core boxing concealing redundant pipework, refurbishment and repolishing of the existing hardwood stair treads, Minor reconfiguration of the upper staircase arrangement with new hardwood winder treads matched to the original, replacement of a non original balustrade, and installation of a small kitchenette area within the penthouse room.
The proposals do not involve alterations to the exterior of the building, external concrete structure, window openings, balcony arrangements or wider appearance of the terrace.
